title: Ortiz2023: Motor imagery during walking with a lower-limb exoskeleton
description: EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants performing kinesthetic motor imagery of gait while walking with a fully assisted lower-limb exoskeleton on flat ground. Trials alternate motor imagery with relaxation and a regressive-count distractor task, cued by auditory stimuli. Data were recorded with 27 EEG and 4 EOG channels at 200 Hz as part of the DECODED EUROBENCH sub-project, and are re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Brain Products actiCHamp system (Ag/AgCl wet electrodes, 27 EEG and 4 EOG channels, 200 Hz sampling rate, left earlobe reference, right earlobe ground, 0.1 Hz high-pass and 50 Hz notch online filters). Participants walked in a fully assisted lower-limb exoskeleton and followed auditory cues for relaxation, kinesthetic motor imagery of gait, or a regressive-count task, in 9 s trials over 16 runs.
